components.name: AnimatePresence
components.summary:
Keeps one native child alive while its exit targets are animated by the Rust renderer.
Keep the boundary itself mounted and toggle `present` so Tarve can retain native identity.

props.name: exit
props.doc: Numeric targets held until their native transitions finish.

props.name: id
props.doc: Stable identity for this presence boundary.

props.name: enter
props.doc: Initial numeric values applied when the native node is first mounted.

props.name: transition
props.doc: Overrides the child's style.transition for enter/exit motion.

components.name: AppMenuBar
components.summary:
A menu bar drawn by the app, in the theme: the same on every system, in a framed or
frameless window, or inside a `TitleBar`. Arrow keys move along the bar and through a
menu, Enter/Space choose, Escape closes; menus open on click and follow the pointer
while one is open, like a system menu bar. `app.menuBar(items)` places one at the top
of the window (after a `TitleBar`) and adds Alt access keys, F10 and accelerators.

props.name: onSelect
props.doc: After an item's own `onSelect`, with its id (`menu-<n>` when it has none).

props.name: flex

props.name: path
props.doc: Optional path used for extension-based language detection.

props.name: showLineNumbers
props.doc: Paint line numbers as non-selectable chrome.

props.doc: Overrides syntax colours without changing parsing or layout.

props.name: wordDiff

components.name: Direction
components.summary: Layout direction helper. RTL reverses visual horizontal flow while preserving logical/focus order. Text bidi is not changed.

components.name: Glass
components.summary:
A container made of Liquid Glass: what scrolls behind it shows through blurred,
bent at the rounded edge, under a light veil, with a bright rim. Compose like a
`View`; controls inside keep their own look.

props.name: appearance
props.doc: Light or dark appearance of the rim and veil. Default `light`.

props.name: blend
props.doc: How far apart in px two merged boxes start bridging; read from the first box of the key. Default 32.

props.name: flex
props.doc: CSS `flex`: `1` is `1 1 0`; strings take any CSS value, e.g. `"1 1 176px"`.

props.name: material
props.doc: Overrides of the material: blur, saturate, refraction, highlight.

props.name: merge
props.doc:
Glass boxes with the same key fuse like drops of liquid: where two come within
`blend` px of each other their shapes bridge smoothly, as one surface. The first
box of the key in tree order paints the surface: its tint, material and `blend`
are the surface's, the others contribute only their shape (up to 8 per key).

props.name: radius
props.doc: Corner radius. Default 26 (a capsule when the box is 52 px tall).

props.name: shadow
props.doc: Outer shadow under the glass. Default on.

props.name: tint
props.doc:
Tint colour laid over the variant's veil; the alpha is the strength. `regular` stays
frosted under it, `clear` shows it nearly alone. A gradient string passes through as is.

props.name: variant
props.doc:
`regular`: frosted, legible over anything (toolbars, tab bars). `clear`: barely
tinted, for controls over media. `tinted`: `tint` shows through strongly.

props.name: src
props.doc:
Local path, `http(s)://` URL, data URL, encoded bytes, or raw RGBA8 pixels.
A URL is fetched and decoded natively, off the UI thread, the first time the
image is on screen (like `loading="lazy"`); until then it shows its placeholder.

props.name: fallbackSrc
props.doc: Shown instead of a string `src` once it fails (an `onerror` swap to a placeholder), until `clearImageSourceCache()`.

props.name: fit
props.doc: CSS `object-fit`.

props.name: onError
props.doc: The source failed to load or decode (HTML `onerror`): a missing file, a bad image, an HTTP error.

props.name: onSubmit
props.doc: Enter (with or without modifiers) submits the current value.

components.name: Spinner
components.summary: A loading indicator: an arc that turns once every 800 ms, rotated natively by `style.spin`.

props.name: submitOnEnter
props.doc: When true, Enter submits and Shift+Enter inserts a newline. Ctrl/Cmd+Enter always submits.

props.name: actions
props.doc: After the title (before the window controls on desktop): icon buttons, a search field.

props.name: appearance
props.doc: Light or dark glass; sets the ink of the title and controls. Default `light`.

props.name: buttonStyle
props.doc: Style merged into each window control (minimize, maximize, close): size, radius, colours.

props.name: flex
props.doc: CSS `flex`: `1` is `1 1 0`; strings take any CSS value, e.g. `"1 1 176px"`.

props.name: glass
props.doc:
Liquid Glass bar: `true` for the `regular` material, or a variant. Its controls go
round. Edge to edge (no `radius` in `style`) it keeps only a hairline along its bottom;
with a `radius` it is a floating capsule with the full rim and shadow. Lay it over
content (`position: "absolute"`) for the backdrop to show through, as the window
background alone is only the veil.

props.name: leading
props.doc: Before the title: a menu button, an avatar. Replaces the back button `onBack` draws.

props.name: onBack
props.doc: Draws a back arrow before the title that calls this: the usual top bar of a pushed screen.

props.name: open
props.doc: Controlled visibility. Omit it and the tooltip shows while its trigger is hovered, one at a time.

components.name: VirtualList
components.summary: Fixed-height rows; the caller keeps `offset` and updates it from `onScroll`.

props.name: onScroll
props.type: (offset: number, max: number, info: ScrollInfo) => void
props.doc: `info.source` tells the user's scrolling from a scrollToItem (and its smooth steps).

props.name: height
props.doc:
Viewport height in px. Omit it (with an `id`) to fill the parent like
`flex: 1`: the list follows its real laid-out height, window resizes included.

props.name: id
props.doc: Stable list id is required so measured heights survive rerenders.

props.name: itemCount
props.doc: Total logical row count; `items` contains only the mounted window.

props.name: windowStart
props.doc: Logical index represented by `items[0]`.

props.name: backdrop
props.doc:
See through the window: `transparent` shows the desktop and windows behind it,
`blur` blurs them (Acrylic on Windows, the system blur on macOS and KDE), `mica`
and `acrylic` are the Windows 11 materials (`blur` elsewhere). The window
background defaults to transparent; give it (or any box) an alpha colour to tint.
Set when the window opens. Where the system or renderer has no alpha (Vello/DX12 on
Windows, X11 without a compositor, the CPU renderer on Wayland and macOS) the window
is opaque, its background drawn without alpha. Mica tints the desktop wallpaper, not
the windows behind; `blur` and `acrylic` blur those. As for the system's own
windows, Mica and Acrylic turn solid while the window is inactive (`blur` stays), and
all three are solid while Windows "Transparency effects" is off
(`app.inspect().transparencyEffects`; `app.onEvent` gets a `transparencyEffects` event
when it changes). The material is light or dark after the window background's
lightness (the app theme), not the system theme.

props.name: desktopWidget
props.doc:
Make the window a desktop widget, `columns` × `rows` cells: frameless, below
every window (unless `level` says otherwise) and off the taskbar.
Windows: sized to the desktop icon grid; when dragged (give it a
`dragRegion`) it drops into the nearest cells free of icons, and icons that
land under it are moved out.
Linux (X11; XWayland on a Wayland session): cells of a typical icon,
80 × 100, on every workspace; no icon grid to follow.
`width`/`height` are ignored; `position` is where it first looks for room.

props.name: flex
props.doc: CSS `flex`: `1` is `1 1 0`; strings take any CSS value, e.g. `"1 1 176px"`.

props.name: frameless
props.doc: No native frame or title bar, without needing a `TitleBar`. Pair with a `dragRegion` to move it.

props.name: level
props.doc:
Stacking order; `alwaysOnBottom` keeps the window under every other one, even
when clicked or shown. Can change while the app runs.

props.name: maximized
props.doc: Opens maximized; `width`/`height`/`position` are the bounds it restores to. A remembered window state wins.

props.name: skipTaskbar
props.doc: Keep the window off the taskbar and out of Alt+Tab (Windows) or the task switcher and pager (Linux, X11).

commonProps.name: class
commonProps.doc: Same as `className`, HTML spelling. Both may be given; `className` comes last.

commonProps.name: className
commonProps.doc: Tailwind utility classes, compiled to `style` at the call site; an explicit `style` wins.

commonProps.name: motionFrom
commonProps.doc: Initial numeric values for a native enter transition.

commonProps.name: onFileDragEnter
commonProps.doc: Files entered the node; `paths` are the dragged files.

commonProps.name: onPaste
commonProps.doc: Receives non-text clipboard content (files or a bitmap) pasted while focused.

commonProps.name: onPointerLeave
commonProps.doc: The pointer left this node and its children (DOM `pointerleave`).

commonProps.name: onPointerMove
commonProps.doc: Pointer position inside this node (like DOM `offsetX`/`offsetY`) while it is over it or its children.

commonProps.name: onSize
commonProps.doc: Content-box size after layout, on mount and whenever it changes (a ResizeObserver).
